verdict.rationale: Several Customer Area (UI) operations have documented API equivalents. The Management API orders terminals 'using API requests instead of the Customer Area', the Terminal API handles payments and refunds that can also be issued from the Customer Area, and the Disputes API covers retrieving, defending and accepting disputes. Adyen also publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub. However, nothing documents complete UI–API parity: terminal management and transaction management from the unified Customer Area are only partially shown as API-accessible, and payout settings are not shown via API. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity statement, evidence that all Customer Area terminal and transaction management is available via API, payout-configuration API coverage, and independent hands-on corroboration.
